source.addressing_reference_use: Read-only Xenos memory-layout reference; no Xenia renderer code or runtime dependency is used.

retail_target_layout_sequence.interpretation: The groups share color EDRAM base 0 while changing extent, MSAA, format, pitch, and depth base. They cannot be rendered as independent Vulkan attachments without preserving and reinterpreting the aliased Xenos sample storage.

implementation.supported_address_model: 32bpp Xenos EDRAM sample coordinates with 80x16-sample tiles, 2048-tile wrap, 1x/2x/4x sample expansion, and the depth tile half-swap.
implementation.renderer_policy: Target-layout changes still fail closed. Diagnostics now identify the first shared color sample address; no aliased target data is silently discarded.

regressions.renderer: Captured 14-draw target metadata is transcribed into the regression fixture. The call is rejected at draw 1 with all 14 ordered layouts and the shared EDRAM sample-0 byte address. The shader and resource payloads are not part of this fixture.

android_arm64.renderer_check: synthetic offscreen Vulkan 1.1 smoke passed on device

device_state.test_artifacts: Temporary ARM64 CPU and Vulkan smoke files were copied to /data/local/tmp, executed, then removed.

limitations: This change maps target sample addresses and pins the retail layout sequence; it does not allocate or populate a Vulkan EDRAM backing store.
Ordered mode-6 Copy/Convert operations are still not executed between target groups.
The 14-draw frame is not yet rendered through the complete transition path, and no disclaimer-to-video parity is claimed.
Several transition shaders and texture descriptors in the capture remain unresolved independently of target persistence.
